create_TensorBase_model: create a TensorBase model with configurable grid size, density components, and shading mode for 3D scene representation
sample_ray_points: sample points along camera rays using sample_ray method with configurable number of samples and bounding box constraints
compute_density_features: compute density features from sampled 3D coordinates using the compute_densityfeature method for volume rendering
render_with_MLPRender_PE: render RGB colors using MLPRender_PE module with positional encoding for both position and view direction inputs
update_alpha_mask: update the alpha mask grid to filter empty space and optimize ray marching performance during training
